notes:
- Discord shows the playtime the launcher has been counting all along, the same number as on the Play page. It was only ever counting the minutes since the bot was switched on, which is why it said a few minutes when you had hours.
- The hour roles go on that real playtime too, so they finally match what you have played.
- Connect Discord opens your browser and ties the accounts together when you sign in there. No code to read off the screen and type in.
- Press it again once connected and it offers to disconnect instead.
